reason: An Agent Skill focused on generating and delivering native Tkinter/ttk desktop applications, including MVC architecture, SQLite persistence, testing, and PyInstaller packaging.

summaries.zh: 面向智能体的 Tkinter/ttk 原生桌面应用开发技能，涵盖架构设计、界面构建、SQLite 数据层、测试验证和 PyInstaller 打包。
summaries.en: An agent skill for building native Tkinter/ttk desktop applications with architecture guidance, UI construction, SQLite persistence, testing, and PyInstaller packaging.
